name: Capillary Technologies India Ltd
title: Capillary Technologies India Ltd - 544614 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: SaaS loyalty platform, not a capital-cycle story: FY26 revenue INR734 crores (+23%), 110% NRR, adjusted EBITDA margin ~14.7%, plus debt-free M&A roll-up (SessionM closed at ~0.5x revenue).

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 26% YoY
triggers.quote: Q4 grew at 26% year-on-year. For the full year, we grew at 23%.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue to cross INR1,000-1,050 crores
triggers.quote: we are comfortable that revenues will cross INR 1,000–1,050 crores in FY27.

triggers.label: Roll-up buying sub-scale loyalty platforms
triggers.quote: we're really doing a roll -up of companies which were great earlier, right?

guidance.quote: we are comfortable that revenues will cross INR 1,000–1,050 crores in FY27.

guidance.value: break-even in year one, slightly positive in year two
guidance.quote: The business sh ould be at a break-even for year one and probably a little bit positive margins for year two.
usually, the way we plan the business, Bharat, is about 115% NRR on the organic business.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We closed that transaction on May 1st.

red_flags.label: Normalised Q4 PAT depends on one-off churn indemnity income
red_flags.quote: in Q4 we had a one-time exceptional income of INR25 crores.

red_flags.label: Management stated FY26 ROCE about 3%
red_flags.quote: return on capital employed, we have seen a constant improvement and today stand at about 3%.

red_flags.label: Margin percentage may dip post SessionM
red_flags.quote: you might see a dip given we have just announced acquisition of SessionM.

evasions.quote: But I don't want to comment on what the future might be given the large ac quisition that we've just done.
